description: Clio Grow inbox and intake leads (not Clio Manage matters), newest first: untriaged inbox first, then Grow matters. Filter by since (default 30 days), status (inbox/intake/hired/declined), type or text. Read-only. Sign-in required.

by.description: Whether since applies to created or last-updated time. Defaults to created.

limit.description: Max leads, newest first, 1-50. Defaults to 15.

query.description: Text in the client's name or the lead description.

since.description: ISO date or timestamp. Defaults to 30 days ago.

status.description: Exact Grow status (e.g. "Hired", "Contract Sent") or category: inbox, intake, hired or declined.

type.description: Text in the lead's matter type, e.g. "DWI" or "Family".

name: list_grow_leads
title: List Clio Grow leads
